name: Better Page Not Found
description: Replaces the content region of core 401/403/404 error pages with a themed message and a homepage/login button.
project_description: Better Page Not Found improves the presentation of Drupal's core error pages (401 unauthorized, 403 access denied and 404 not found). On those routes it replaces the page content region with a small themed template that shows a fixed, translatable message and a call-to-action button, while leaving the surrounding theme (header, footer, styling) intact. The 404 page shows 'The requested page could not be found.'; the 401 and 403 pages show 'Sorry, you are not authorized to access this page.'. A button beneath the message links to the homepage by default; a settings form lets an administrator make the access-denied (401/403) button link to the user login page instead. Styling is provided by a single CSS library targeting the .c-system-message, .c-system-message__text and .c-system-message__button classes, which site builders can override. The module has no dependencies beyond Drupal core.
